The scratch and spot of the figure, 918 pixels in all, on two 160 x 160 test images. The numbers are the PSNR in dB inside the hole, against the image before the damage. On a ramp that rises by 1 level per pixel to the right, the largest error in the hole is 7 levels for Telea, 4 for Navier-Stokes and 0 for biharmonic, since a plane is its own biharmonic fill.
